brief:
King's College London has lifted the suspension of Egyptian student Usama Ghanem following a year-long legal and public campaign, Middle East Eye reported. The university's reversal ends disciplinary action taken against the pro-Palestine activist, whose case drew sustained attention from campus organizing groups.

Pro-Palestine student organizations mounted a coordinated response to challenge the suspension, organizing marches and pursuing legal remedies throughout the dispute. Ghanem's reinstatement reflects the outcome of that sustained pressure and legal effort. The decision represents a shift in how the institution has addressed activism on campus related to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

title: King's College London restores pro-Palestine student's status
